capture: tools/list over stdio against the built server (node dist/index.js), 2026-09-13

query.description: Search keywords. Required. Example: 'iPhone 15 Pro', 'PlayStation 5', 'gaming mouse Logitech'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20, max 50.

page.description: 1-indexed page number for paginating beyond `limit` results.

sort.description: Sort order, default 'relevance'. Price (asc/desc) and rating sorts are applied to the fetched result page (up to ~20 items per page), not the whole catalog — Alza's search page ignores server-side sort parameters. For the cheapest match overall, use a larger `limit` or combine with `min_price`/`max_price`.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the locale's currency.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the locale's currency.

in_stock.description: If true, only return products that are available right now.

category_id.description: Restrict the search to a specific category id. Use list_categories to discover ids.

code.description: Alza product code, e.g. 'WEXOA002B0'. This is the canonical identifier returned by `search_products` (the `code` field). Not the numeric id.
Alza product code, e.g. 'WEXOA002B0'. Same as the `code` from `search_products`.

limit.description: Maximum number of individual reviews to include. Default 10, max 50.

postal_code.description: Czech (or other supported country) postal code. Examples: '110 00', '11000', '602 00'. Spaces are tolerated.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres. Default 15 km.

limit.description: Maximum number of pickup points to return. Default 10.

types.description: Restrict to specific pickup-point types. 'branch' = brick-and-mortar AlzaShop with staff (currently the only type that returns results). 'alzabox' = self-service parcel locker — accepted, but AlzaBox discovery is not yet implemented so it returns nothing. Default: both.

parent_id.description: Parent category id. Omit to list top-level categories. Pass an id from a previous result to drill down.

code.description: Authorization code from the `alza://identity` redirect (the `code` query parameter).

state.description: State value returned by `auth_start`; must match the pending PKCE session exactly.

tools.name: mobile_read
tools.title: Read a raw Alza mobile API operation

operation.description: Which fixed, APK-confirmed mobile API read operation to execute. See the tool description for per-operation arguments.

args.description: Operation-specific arguments as a JSON object, e.g. router_product: {product_id: 13078770}; web_after_payment_dialog: {order_id: "..."}. Omit for operations that take none.

action.description: Which mutation you are about to perform; the token will only be accepted by that action's tool.
Which whitelisted mutation to execute; determines the expected `payload` shape.

confirmation_token.description: One-time token from `prepare_mutation` prepared with this same `action`.

payload.description: Mutation payload matching the mobile DTO for `action`, e.g. coupon_add: {coupon: "CODE"}; coupon_remove: {couponId: 123}; basket_update: {basket_id: 1, flag: true}.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add a product to the account cart

code.description: Alza product code, e.g. 'RI054b1' (the `code` field from `search_products`).

quantity.description: How many units to add. Default 1, max 99.

selected_delivery_option_id.description: Delivery option id from a prior response to anchor the group listing on a chosen delivery method. Omit for the default listing.

association.description: The DeliveryPaymentAssociation object copied from the `delivery_options` response for the chosen pickup point.

selected_delivery_option_id.description: Delivery option id from `delivery_options` to preview that specific delivery method. Omit for the server default.

delivery_payment.description: SelectedDeliveryPayment object copied from the checkout/delivery response.

user_info.description: SendOrderUserInfo object (contact + address fields) copied from or confirmed against the profile/address book.

complete_order.description: SendCompleteOrder object copied from the checkout response.

order_id.description: Basket/order id of the current checkout (from the basket context), if any.

group_id.description: Delivery group id (from delivery options), if any.

latitude.description: Latitude to centre the search on (WGS84).

longitude.description: Longitude to centre the search on (WGS84).

types.description: Pickup type filter (e.g. 1=AlzaBox, 2=branches); omit for all types.

limit.description: Page size for the place list. Default server value.

offset.description: Pagination offset for the place list.

place_id.description: Fetch the detail for a single place (the call the web UI fires on place selection).

tools.name: web_add_to_cart
tools.title: Add a product to the web visitor cart

commodity_id.description: Numeric Alza commodity id (e.g. 7229946; the numeric id from `get_product`/`search_products`).

count.description: How many units to add. Default 1, max 99.

basket_id.description: Basket id returned by `web_add_to_cart` (the current web basket).

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. 'CZ'. Defaults to CZ.

referrer.description: Referrer URL for the chat context, if known.

force_initialize.description: Force a fresh chat initialization instead of reusing the session.

list_category_id.description: Product-context categories; the server requires the field — an empty array works without context.

commodity_code.description: Alza product code for the product-detail context (page_type 1).

commodity_type.description: Commodity type id for the product-detail context.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer name for the product-detail context, if known.

entity_id.description: Entity id for the page context, if known.

seo_prefix.description: SEO prefix from the product page URL, if known.

pwd.description: Initial password. It is a credential — confirm with the user before sending.

tools.title: Place an order (legacy web WCF — working path)

delivery_id.description: Delivery option id (e.g. 2680 for AlzaBox; from `delivery_options`).
